body:
Hey @mrchrisadams thanks for your kind words, really interesting idea to provide visibility into the environment impact of each request! 

In theory this would be possible. There is a response header from Litellm when querying api.publicai.co. 
e.g. x-litellm-model-api-base | https://vllm.svc.cscs.ch/apertus-70b-instruct/v1

However, this would be difficult to do within Open WebUI as the response headers are not available to OWUI functions. That is why I had resorted to just doing a random attribution based on our weights for the sponsor attribution for now! 

For our demo chat on the landing page, we are using assistant-ui on the backend. I think this is more flexible than OWUI so its definitely easier there, just haven't had the time to prioritize this. 


Beyond just these technical limitations, in terms of the accuracy of measuring "environmental impact", even with 0 requests, we are still running dedicated servers to host the models. The reality is that it's hard to provide accurate estimates without sufficient volume or historical data as this cost is usually amortized / shared amongst many users.
